title: FIPS DNS backend adapter (Phase C.3)
intended_behavior: Provide a DNS Backend implementation for FIPS hosts-file aliases.
Expose backend type fips as a valid DNS backend type.
Synchronize only DNS records whose values can be represented in FIPS hosts entries: npub values or fd00::/8 overlay addresses.
Preserve operator-managed hosts file content outside a Bahia-managed section.
List .fips hosts entries as CNAME-like DNS records.
